Living Well / Free resources

Make, edit & communicate

A useful way in

Choose one place to begin.

Turn an idea into an image, short recording, story, or accessible piece of media with a deliberately small first project.

Creative usefulness includes enjoyment, expression, and making something understandable to another person. Choose a tool for a particular medium rather than collecting an entire production suite. A finished small piece is more useful than an elaborate abandoned setup.

Start with: Twine: an interactive story. Build a three-passage story using the beginner reference, then export a copy.

GIMP: edit an imageKrita: draw and paintShotcut: a small video editKdenlive: a more layered editOBS Studio: record a demonstrationTwine: an interactive storyW3C: accessible audio and video

Resources with a clear purpose.

Image editing · Free core app

GIMP: edit an image

GIMP project

Prepare a photograph or graphic for a small project while keeping an original you can return to.

Begin here: Use the official tutorials for a crop, resize, or simple correction on a copy.

Access: Free open-source desktop editor for supported Windows, macOS, and Linux systems.

Perspective: Official product documentation; selected for a bounded everyday task.

Open GIMP: edit an image

Context & source

Advanced editing has a learning curve. Do not pass a composite or generated addition off as evidence of an event, and check permissions for source images.

Drawing and painting · Free core app

Krita: draw and paint

Krita community

Make room for visual expression rather than treating every creative idea as something to automate.

Begin here: Try a small sketch with a familiar brush; learn layers only when they help the piece.

Access: Free open-source painting software from the official site. Compatible hardware is needed; store editions and optional extras may differ.

Perspective: Official product documentation; selected for a bounded everyday task.

Open Krita: draw and paint

Context & source

Equipment and practice remain separate from software access. A paper sketch is an equally valid starting point for a modest idea.

Video editing · Free core app

Shotcut: a small video edit

Meltytech

Join a few approved clips into a short sequence rather than beginning with a complex production system.

Begin here: Follow a beginner tutorial and export a short test before editing a long recording.

Access: Free open-source editor for supported Windows, macOS, and Linux systems. Media, storage, and processing requirements still apply.

Perspective: Official product documentation; selected for a bounded everyday task.

Open Shotcut: a small video edit

Context & source

Use the official download rather than an advertisement. Check sound, permission, captions, and the exported file, not only the editing preview.

Source information reviewed 2026-10-10. Provider details.

Video editing · Free core app

Kdenlive: a more layered edit

KDE community

An alternative when a project needs multiple tracks, titles, or a more developed editing workflow.

Begin here: Read the user manual and finish a short test sequence before moving a larger project.

Access: Free open-source video editor on supported desktop platforms; device capability and storage affect practical use.

Perspective: Official product documentation; selected for a bounded everyday task.

Open Kdenlive: a more layered edit

Context & source

More features can mean more setup. Compare with the editor you already understand, and review automated transcripts rather than treating them as final captions.

Screen and video recording · Free core app

OBS Studio: record a demonstration

OBS Project

Show how a useful process actually works through a short recording of approved material.

Begin here: Set up a local recording, capture a harmless sample, and play it back before sharing.

Access: Free open-source recording software for supported Windows, macOS, and Linux systems. A microphone or camera is optional by project.

Perspective: Official product documentation; selected for a bounded everyday task.

Open OBS Studio: record a demonstration

Context & source

Hide notifications and private windows before capture. Recording and broadcasting are different actions; a local test does not require going live.

Interactive storytelling · Free browser interactive

Twine: an interactive story

Twine community

Explore an idea through choices and connected passages instead of writing another linear essay.

Begin here: Build a three-passage story using the beginner reference, then export a copy.

Access: Free open-source browser and desktop tool. Publishing or hosting the resulting story is a separate decision.

Perspective: Official product documentation; selected for a bounded everyday task.

Open Twine: an interactive story

Context & source

Browser work needs a deliberate backup. Check each path and label fictional situations rather than presenting them as a record of real events.

Practical reference · Free to browse

W3C: accessible audio and video

W3C Web Accessibility Initiative

Plan a creative piece so that more people can understand it, including people who cannot see or hear every element.

Begin here: Start with the planning section, then choose the guidance on captions, transcripts, or description that fits the piece.

Access: Free public guidance; creating and checking accessible media still takes work and may require tools or assistance.

Perspective: Web accessibility guidance from a standards organization.

Open W3C: accessible audio and video

Context & source

Captions, descriptions, and transcripts do different jobs. This resource is guidance, not certification that a finished video is accessible.

Keep the context

Take what is useful, thoughtfully.

Keep originals and review exports. Obtain permission for other people’s material and preserve the difference between illustration and documentation. Captions, descriptive narration, and text alternatives belong in the plan.

Selections are based on public source review, not a claim that Nolan uses every resource or belongs to the organizations listed.
